summary: Implement a robust local development environment using Docker Compose with PostgreSQL (pgvector) and Redis, including Spring Boot integration and environment-based configuration.

plan.title: Configure Environment Variables
plan.description: Create a .env file to manage database credentials and ports, and update .gitignore to exclude it from version control.

plan.title: Define Infrastructure with Docker Compose
plan.description: Create docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL (pgvector/pgvector:pg17) and Redis (redis:7-alpine) services, including healthchecks and volume persistence.

plan.title: Create Initialization Scripts
plan.description: Create init-db.sql to enable the 'vector' extension in PostgreSQL automatically on startup.

plan.title: Enable Spring Boot Docker Compose Support
plan.description: Add 'spring-boot-docker-compose' dependency to pom.xml and configure application.properties to enable automatic service management.

plan.title: Document Development Environment
plan.description: Update README.md with instructions on how to start, stop, and manage the local infrastructure using Docker Compose.

acceptance_criteria.description: File `docker-compose.yml` exists and defines 'postgres' and 'redis' services.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Check existence of `docker-compose.yml` and its content for service definitions.
Verify `.env` file content locally (not in repo).

acceptance_criteria.description: File `init-db.sql` contains `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;`.

risks: Docker might not be installed or running on the developer's machine.
Port conflicts if 5432 or 6379 are already in use by local services.
Potential version mismatch between local Docker/Docker Compose and the defined images.
